title: The Meaning of NO1
content:
In the hearts of the creators behind YURI1,
YURI is No.1.

To create YURI NO1 in this era is, in itself, one of the No.1 things we are most thankful for.

For us here who create YURI1, YURI is simply part of who we are.

It is our O₂.
It is part of our existence.
It is part of our everyday lives,
something so familiar that we can hardly imagine our lives without it.

And throughout all the years we are given,
we hope to leave something behind—
something that proves
YURI has existed within the deepest parts of our hearts.

Something that cannot be erased.
Something that cannot fade away.

Through billions upon billions of years,
until the very end of time,
YURI will remain the No.1 choice of the YURI1 creative team.
